title: Bound on permuted indices
statement: For natural numbers $m,n,k,v$, if $v<m+n+k$, then the interval permutation that sends $v<m$ to $n+v$, sends $m\le v<m+n$ to $v-m$, and fixes $v\ge m+n$ sends $v$ to a number less than $n+m+k$.
